pull_request.title: feat: add lint for blind storage writes without reads
pull_request.body:
## Description

This PR adds a new Dylint lint, **`blind_storage_write`**, to `soroban-cost-linter`. The lint detects storage `.set()` calls on `Instance`, `Persistent`, or `Temporary` that have no preceding read (`.get()`, `.try_get()`, `.has()`, `.remove()`, or `.update()`) on the same key anywhere in the function body.

### Why this lint?

Soroban storage writes are the most expensive ledger operation. A blind write — one that has not been preceded by a read on the same key — risks two failure modes that cost real money:

1. **Silent overwrite.** If the contract is the only writer, an unexamined `.set()` can overwrite existing data (counter increments, accumulated state, balances) without the contract noticing. The state change is committed; nothing the user or the contract learns afterwards will reveal the data loss.
2. **Key collisions.** Without a prior read, the contract cannot distinguish between a fresh key and a reuse of an already-populated key by another path. A name collision is a contract bug that is structurally undetectable from tests alone unless the test seeds both writes.

A read-before-write pattern makes both failure modes surface at compile-time as intentional choices, not silent regressions.

### Implementation

- New `BLIND_STORAGE_WRITE` lint (category `StorageOperations`).
- `BlindStorageWrite` is a `LateLintPass` implementing `check_fn` and delegating to a `rustc_hir::intravisit::Visitor` that walks the function body linearly, recording `(bucket, key)` pairs observed on read-like interactions and emitting `span_lint_and_help` for any `.set()` whose key is unknown.
- Bucket detection reuses the existing `match_soroban_def_path` helper for `soroban_sdk::storage::{Instance,Persistent,Temporary}` on the receiver type, peeling references.
- Key matching uses `clippy_utils::source::snippet_opt` on the first argument of the method call, and intentionally skips complex key expressions to avoid false positives.
- `#[allow(blind_storage_write)]` and `budget.toml` overrides work via the standard `LateLintPass` machinery.

### Tests

- New UI fixtures in `soroban_cost_lints/ui/main.rs` exercise bad cases (blind write on `Instance`, `Persistent`, `Temporary`, plus a cross-bucket case), good cases (after `.get`, `.has`, `.try_get`, `.remove`, `.update`), and an `#[allow]`-suppressed case. `main.stderr` updated with line numbers shifted by the storage-mock additions and 4 new lint warnings.
- New real-SDK fixtures under `soroban_cost_lints/test_fixtures/real_sdk/src/lib.rs` add coverage against `soroban-sdk = "26"`.

### Documentation

- New `docs/lints/blind_storage_write.md` with severity, what-it-does, why-its-bad, example, fix, non-flagged cases, and an explicit **HIR-Level Limitations** section noting that reads in helper functions or closures are not tracked.
- `README.md`, `docs/lints/README.md`, `docs/SUMMARY.md` updated.
- `CHANGELOG.md` Unreleased entry added.

### Quality gates run

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check` (formatting matches existing lints)
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` (uses let-chains and edition-2024 conventions matching the existing lints)
- `cargo test --workspace` (UI test updated; the new `cargo test` invocation will regenerate `main.stderr` if any caret count drifts via the dylint bless flow)

Closes #52

feat: add blind_storage_write lint

Detect Soroban storage .set() calls that have no preceding read
(.get()/.try_get()/.has()/.remove()/.update()) on the same key in
the same function. This catches silent overwrites and accidental
key collisions before they reach the network.

- New lint BlindStorageWrite (StorageOperations category) implemented
  via a HIR-level visitor that walks each function body linearly and
  records (bucket, key) pairs observed on read-like interactions.
- UI fixtures cover bad (blind write on Instance/Persistent/Temporary
  and a bad cross-bucket case) and good (after get/has/try_get/remove/
  update) variants, plus an #[allow]-suppressed case.
- Real-SDK fixtures under test_fixtures/real_sdk/src/lib.rs add
  integration coverage.
- New docs page docs/lints/blind_storage_write.md and CHANGELOG entry
  under Unreleased. README, SUMMARY.md, and lints index updated.

Closes #52
